column1: Old School RuneScape Wiki jingle cache ids, harvested from Category:Jingles
(https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/wiki/Category:Jingles, 324 pages) via the
MediaWiki API (action=query&prop=revisions, batched 40 titles at a time,
2026-08-14), reading each page's infobox `|cacheid=` field.
`cacheid` is the JS5 index-11 (music jingles) archive/group id -- verified,
not assumed, three independent ways (see docs/AUDIO_ACCURACY.md and
tools/gen_jingle_names.py):
- name-hash proof on the sibling index-6 (music tracks) table, which DOES
carry name hashes -- 7/7 sampled wiki cacheids resolved to the archive-6
group whose stored hash matches the lowercased track name
- id-set identity: all 314 wiki jingle cacheids fall in exactly the
315-entry archive-11 group id set of cache.osrs239 (314 of 315 -- the one
miss, id 178, has no wiki page; id 17 likewise)
- independent MIDI note-event match against LostCity's 74 named 2004
jingle .mid files (66/74 exact -- see gen_jingle_names.py)
314 of 315 archive-11 ids resolved this way. Ids 17 and 178 have no wiki
page and keep jingle_<id> in the pack. `cacheid=11488` on "Yama's Jingle" is
out of range for this table (max valid id is index-11's own count) and is
treated as a wiki error, not a row -- the generator only trusts an id inside
the cache's own group id set.
